choices.content: Runners in the outer lanes have better physical fitness.
The straight sections in the outer lanes are shorter.
To make the competition venue more attractive.
The bends in the outer lanes are longer, so their starting lines must be moved forward to ensure that runners in all lanes cover the same distance.

question.prompt: In a 400 m race, the starting lines are at different positions in different lanes, with the starting lines for runners in the outer lanes farther forward. What is the main reason?

solutions.explanation: The bends in the outer lanes have larger radii and are longer. To ensure that every runner covers the same total distance, the starting lines in the outer lanes must be moved forward appropriately.
solutions.title: Compare the bend lengths
